name: Content embed
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Content embed.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Enter the kicker. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Title
settings.how: Enter the title. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Description
settings.default: Use this section to place third-party content inside a frame. Add your provider’s embed code.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Embed code
settings.info: Paste your provider’s iframe, script or HTML. Give iframes a descriptive title. Empty sections hide on the storefront. Provider behavior must be checked after editor reloads.
settings.how: Write the embed code. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Embed mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for embed mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Custom ratio (padding-top %)

settings.label: Allow horizontal scroll inside frame
settings.how: Turn on “Allow horizontal scroll inside frame” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
